Text: For this new-married man approaching here, Whose salt imagination yet hath wrong'd Your well defended honour, you must pardon For Mariana's sake: but as he adjudged your brother,-- Being criminal, in double violation Of sacred chastity and of promise-breach Thereon dependent, for your brother's life,-- The very mercy of the law cries out Most audible, even from his proper tongue, 'An Angelo for Claudio, death for death!' Haste still pays haste, and leisure answers leisure; Like doth quit like, and MEASURE still FOR MEASURE. Then, Angelo, thy fault's thus manifested; Which, though thou wouldst deny, denies thee vantage. We do condemn thee to the very block Where Claudio stoop'd to death, and with like haste. Away with him!
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: That at her hands which the king's King forbids.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: He cannot temperately transport his honours From where he should begin and end, but will Lose those he hath won.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: This is strange now: do you two know how you are censured here in the city, I mean of us o' the right-hand file? do you?
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Let's hence, and hear How the dispatch is made, and in what fashion, More than his singularity, he goes Upon this present action.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: No might nor greatness in mortality Can censure 'scape; back-wounding calumny The whitest virtue strikes. What king so strong Can tie the gall up in the slanderous tongue? But who comes here?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Norfolk, we must have knocks; ha! must we not?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Had not you come upon your cue, my lord William Lord Hastings had pronounced your part,-- I mean, your voice,--for crowning of the king.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: By the vow of mine order I warrant you, if my instructions may be your guide. Let this Barnardine be this morning executed, and his head born to Angelo.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Our Earl of Warwick, Edward's greatest friend.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Sin from thy lips? O trespass sweetly urged! Give me my sin again.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Courage, man; the hurt cannot be much.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Dear sir, ere long I'll visit you again.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: O, did you so? And do you remember what you said of the duke?
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Marrying a punk, my lord, is pressing to death, whipping, and hanging.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: The selfsame name, but one of better nature.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: For what reason, I beseech you?
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Enforced thee! art thou king, and wilt be forced? I shame to hear thee speak. Ah, timorous wretch! Thou hast undone thyself, thy son and me; And given unto the house of York such head As thou shalt reign but by their sufferance. To entail him and his heirs unto the crown, What is it, but to make thy sepulchre And creep into it far before thy time? Warwick is chancellor and the lord of Calais; Stern Falconbridge commands the narrow seas; The duke is made protector of the realm; And yet shalt thou be safe? such safety finds The trembling lamb environed with wolves. Had I been there, which am a silly woman, The soldiers should have toss'd me on their pikes Before I would have granted to that act.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: So, I am satisfied. Give me a bowl of wine: I have not that alacrity of spirit, Nor cheer of mind, that I was wont to have. Set it down. Is ink and paper ready?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Good my friends, If you have heard your general talk of Rome, And of his friends there, it is lots to blanks, My name hath touch'd your ears it is Menenius.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: That is no slander, sir, which is a truth; And what I spake, I spake it to my face.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Farewell, thou woful welcomer of glory!
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: They love not poison that do poison need, Nor do I thee: though I did wish him dead, I hate the murderer, love him murdered. The guilt of conscience take thou for thy labour,
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: I dream'd a dream to-night.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Consider further, That when he speaks not like a citizen, You find him like a soldier: do not take His rougher accents for malicious sounds, But, as I say, such as become a soldier, Rather than envy you.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: A blessed labour, my most sovereign liege: Amongst this princely heap, if any here, By false intelligence, or wrong surmise, Hold me a foe; If I unwittingly, or in my rage, Have aught committed that is hardly borne By any in this presence, I desire
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Still thus, and thus; still worse!
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Nothing that I respect, my gracious lord.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: 'Though all at once cannot See what I do deliver out to each, Yet I can make my audit up, that all From me do back receive the flour of all, And leave me but the bran.' What say you to't?
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Peace, master marquess, you are malapert: Your fire-new stamp of honour is scarce current. O, that your young nobility could judge What 'twere to lose it, and be miserable! They that stand high have many blasts to shake them; And if they fall, they dash themselves to pieces.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Go, see him out at gates, and follow him, As he hath followed you, with all despite; Give him deserved vexation. Let a guard Attend us through the city.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: O, that it were as like as it is true!
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: What, art thou ashamed of me?
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Come hither, Isabel. Your friar is now your prince: as I was then Advertising and holy to your business, Not changing heart with habit, I am still Attorney'd at your service.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Ay me! what news? why dost thou wring thy hands?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Can sick men play so nicely with their names?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Here's such a coil! come, what says Romeo?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Go, some of you convey him to the Tower.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Cannot be! We have record that very well it can, And three examples of the like have been Within my age. But reason with the fellow, Before you punish him, where he heard this, Lest you shall chance to whip your information And beat the messenger who bids beware Of what is to be dreaded.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Welcome, sweet prince, to London, to your chamber.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: How well my comfort is revived by this!
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: What tongueless blocks were they! would not they speak?
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Doubly divorced! Bad men, you violate A twofold marriage, 'twixt my crown and me, And then betwixt me and my married wife. Let me unkiss the oath 'twixt thee and me; And yet not so, for with a kiss 'twas made. Part us, Northumberland; I toward the north, Where shivering cold and sickness pines the clime; My wife to France: from whence, set forth in pomp, She came adorned hither like sweet May, Sent back like Hallowmas or short'st of day.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: My gracious lord, I come but for mine own.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: First, the gods bless you for your tidings; next, Accept my thankfulness.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Cousin, throw up your gage; do you begin.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: As I remember, Henry the Sixth Did prophesy that Richmond should be king, When Richmond was a little peevish boy. A king, perhaps, perhaps,--
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Lady, you know no rules of charity, Which renders good for bad, blessings for curses.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Is this your speeding? nay, then, good night our part!
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Northumberland, then present, wept to see it.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Must die to-morrow! O injurious love, That respites me a life, whose very comfort Is still a dying horror!
Speaker: JULIET

Text: 'Twas not your valour, Clifford, drove me thence.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: I am inform'd that he comes towards London,
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Nor none that live, I hope.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: An offer, uncle, that we will accept: But we must win your grace to go with us To Bristol castle, which they say is held By Bushy, Bagot and their complices, The caterpillars of the commonwealth, Which I have sworn to weed and pluck away.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Patience, good Katharina, and Baptista too. Upon my life, Petruchio means but well,
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: But I know none, and therefore am no beast.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Because thy father Henry did usurp; And thou no more are prince than she is queen.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Who can be patient in such extremes? Ah, wretched man! would I had died a maid And never seen thee, never borne thee son, Seeing thou hast proved so unnatural a father Hath he deserved to lose his birthright thus? Hadst thou but loved him half so well as I, Or felt that pain which I did for him once, Or nourish'd him as I did with my blood, Thou wouldst have left thy dearest heart-blood there, Rather than have that savage duke thine heir And disinherited thine only son.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Be not so hot; the duke Dare no more stretch this finger of mine than he Dare rack his own: his subject am I not, Nor here provincial. My business in this state Made me a looker on here in Vienna, Where I have seen corruption boil and bubble Till it o'er-run the stew; laws for all faults, But faults so countenanced, that the strong statutes Stand like the forfeits in a barber's shop, As much in mock as mark.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: She'll take the enterprise upon her, father, If you advise it.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Now, Warwick, wilt thou ope the city gates, Speak gentle words and humbly bend thy knee, Call Edward king and at his hands beg mercy? And he shall pardon thee these outrages.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Who knows not where a wasp does wear his sting? In his tail.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: What, talking with a priest, lord chamberlain? Your friends at Pomfret, they do need the priest; Your honour hath no shriving work in hand.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: What, weeping-ripe, my Lord Northumberland? Think but upon the wrong he did us all, And that will quickly dry thy melting tears.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Alas, why would you heap these cares on me? I am unfit for state and majesty; I do beseech you, take it not amiss; I cannot nor I will not yield to you.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: O me, the gods! You must not speak of that: you must desire them To think upon you.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: With what a sharp-provided wit he reasons! To mitigate the scorn he gives his uncle,
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: I say it is the moon that shines so bright.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: And yet I come not well.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: A hundred thousand welcomes. I could weep And I could laugh, I am light and heavy. Welcome. A curse begin at very root on's heart, That is not glad to see thee! You are three That Rome should dote on: yet, by the faith of men, We have some old crab-trees here at home that will not Be grafted to your relish. Yet welcome, warriors: We call a nettle but a nettle and The faults of fools but folly.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: You lie, in faith; for you are call'd plain Kate, And bonny Kate and sometimes Kate the curst; But Kate, the prettiest Kate in Christendom Kate of Kate Hall, my super-dainty Kate, For dainties are all Kates, and therefore, Kate, Take this of me, Kate of my consolation; Hearing thy mildness praised in every town, Thy virtues spoke of, and thy beauty sounded, Yet not so deeply as to thee belongs, Myself am moved to woo thee for my wife.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: If I should be! I had rather be a pedlar: Far be it from my heart, the thought of it!
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: How high a pitch his resolution soars! Thomas of Norfolk, what say'st thou to this?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Sweet, so would I: Yet I should kill thee with much cherishing. Good night, good night! parting is such sweet sorrow, That I shall say good night till it be morrow.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Yes, one place else, if you will hear me name it.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: I must away to-day, before night come: Make it no wonder; if you knew my business, You would entreat me rather go than stay. And, honest company, I thank you all, That have beheld me give away myself To this most patient, sweet and virtuous wife: Dine with my father, drink a health to me; For I must hence; and farewell to you all.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Then at my lodging, an it like you: There doth my father lie; and there, this night, We'll pass the business privately and well.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: This is the rascal; this is he I spoke of.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Up with my tent there! here will I lie tonight; But where to-morrow?  Well, all's one for that. Who hath descried the number of the foe?
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Did ever Dian so become a grove As Kate this chamber with her princely gait? O, be thou Dian, and let her be Kate; And then let Kate be chaste and Dian sportful!
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Why, then the maid is mine from all the world, By your firm promise: Gremio is out-vied.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Very well mended. Kiss him for that, good widow.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Northumberland, thou ladder wherewithal The mounting Bolingbroke ascends my throne, The time shall not be many hours of age More than it is ere foul sin gathering head Shalt break into corruption: thou shalt think, Though he divide the realm and give thee half, It is too little, helping him to all; And he shall think that thou, which know'st the way To plant unrightful kings, wilt know again, Being ne'er so little urged, another way To pluck him headlong from the usurped throne. The love of wicked men converts to fear; That fear to hate, and hate turns one or both To worthy danger and deserved death.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: O, welcome, Oxford! for we want thy help.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Some report a sea-maid spawned him; some, that he was begot between two stock-fishes. But it is certain that when he makes water his urine is congealed ice; that I know to be true: and he is a motion generative; that's infallible.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: I will confess to you that I love him.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Go, after, after, cousin Buckingham.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Among them know you one Vincentio?
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: As I intend to prosper and repent, So thrive I in my dangerous attempt Of hostile arms! myself myself confound! Heaven and fortune bar me happy hours! Day, yield me not thy light; nor, night, thy rest! Be opposite all planets of good luck To my proceedings, if, with pure heart's love, Immaculate devotion, holy thoughts, I tender not thy beauteous princely daughter! In her consists my happiness and thine; Without her, follows to this land and me, To thee, herself, and many a Christian soul, Death, desolation, ruin and decay: It cannot be avoided but by this; It will not be avoided but by this. Therefore, good mother,--I must can you so--
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Ay, with my heart And punish them to your height of pleasure. Thou foolish friar, and thou pernicious woman, Compact with her that's gone, think'st thou thy oaths, Though they would swear down each particular saint, Were testimonies against his worth and credit That's seal'd in approbation? You, Lord Escalus, Sit with my cousin; lend him your kind pains To find out this abuse, whence 'tis derived. There is another friar that set them on; Let him be sent for.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: What say'st thou, my dear nurse?
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: True, when avoided grace makes destiny: My babes were destined to a fairer death, If grace had bless'd thee with a fairer life.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Madam, in happy time, what day is that?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Doth he so seek his life?
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: An easy task; 'tis but to love a king.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: You have stood your limitation; and the tribunes Endue you with the people's voice: remains That, in the official marks invested, you Anon do meet the senate.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Rode he on Barbary? Tell me, gentle friend, How went he under him?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: That's worthily As any ear can hear. Come, let's not weep. If I could shake off but one seven years From these old arms and legs, by the good gods, I'ld with thee every foot.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Why, then, thy husband's lands I freely give thee.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: What were I best to say? her father's brother Would be her lord? or shall I say, her uncle? Or, he that slew her brothers and her uncles? Under what title shall I woo for thee, That God, the law, my honour and her love, Can make seem pleasing to her tender years?
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Chop off his head, man; somewhat we will do: And, look, when I am king, claim thou of me The earldom of Hereford, and the moveables Whereof the king my brother stood possess'd.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: No, my good lord; Nor wish'd to hold my peace.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: I'll go along, no such sight to be shown, But to rejoice in splendor of mine own.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Should dying men flatter with those that live?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: The more we stay, the stronger grows our foe.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Where is he, hear you?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: You do blaspheme the good in mocking me.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Thou'rt i' the right, girl; more o, that.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: What means our cousin, that he stares and looks So wildly?
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Have you no countermand for Claudio yet, But he must die to-morrow?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Katharina, I charge thee, tell these headstrong women What duty they do owe their lords and husbands.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Prove it, Henry, and thou shalt be king.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Lords, you that here are under our arrest, Procure your sureties for your days of answer. Little are we beholding to your love, And little look'd for at your helping hands.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: How! no more! As for my country I have shed my blood, Not fearing outward force, so shall my lungs Coin words till their decay against those measles, Which we disdain should tatter us, yet sought The very way to catch them.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Pray you, go to him.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: With Rosaline, my ghostly father? no; I have forgot that name, and that name's woe.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Stand all apart Cousin of Buckingham!
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: 'Tis well, sir, that you hunted for yourself: 'Tis thought your deer does hold you at a bay.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Take heed you dally not before your king; Lest he that is the supreme King of kings Confound your hidden falsehood, and award Either of you to be the other's end.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Go, rate thy minions, proud insulting boy! Becomes it thee to be thus bold in terms Before thy sovereign and thy lawful king?
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: I do repent me, as it is an evil, And take the shame with joy.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: I do demand, If you submit you to the people's voices, Allow their officers and are content To suffer lawful censure for such faults As shall be proved upon you?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Never crave him; we are definitive.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Oh, who shall hinder me to wail and weep, To chide my fortune, and torment myself? I'll join with black despair against my soul, And to myself become an enemy.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Noble lady! Come, go with us; speak fair: you may salve so, Not what is dangerous present, but the loss Of what is past.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: If thou love me, 'tis time thou wert away.
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: Is't possible that so short a time can alter the condition of a man!
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: The fixture of her eye has motion in't, As we are mock'd with art.
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Pray now, your news? You have made fair work, I fear me.--Pray, your news?-- If Marcius should be join'd with Volscians,--
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: My lord, your promise for the earldom,--
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: And shall have your will, because our king: Yet hasty marriage seldom proveth well.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Hence, rotten thing! or I shall shake thy bones Out of thy garments.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: O no, my reasons are too deep and dead; Too deep and dead, poor infants, in their grave.
Speaker: QUEEN ELIZABETH

Text: Well, forward, forward! thus the bowl should run, And not unluckily against the bias. But, soft! company is coming here. Good morrow, gentle mistress: where away? Tell me, sweet Kate, and tell me truly too, Hast thou beheld a fresher gentlewoman? Such war of white and red within her cheeks! What stars do spangle heaven with such beauty, As those two eyes become that heavenly face? Fair lovely maid, once more good day to thee. Sweet Kate, embrace her for her beauty's sake.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Upon record, my gracious lord.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: Your plaintain-leaf is excellent for that.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: A greater gift than that I'll give my cousin.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Then Clarence is at hand, I hear his drum.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Why, then I would not fly. Ah, Montague, If thou be there, sweet brother, take my hand. And with thy lips keep in my soul awhile! Thou lovest me not; for, brother, if thou didst, Thy tears would wash this cold congealed blood That glues my lips and will not let me speak. Come quickly, Montague, or I am dead.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: O pretty Isabella, I am pale at mine heart to see thine eyes so red: thou must be patient. I am fain to dine and sup with water and bran; I dare not for my head fill my belly; one fruitful meal would set me to 't. But they say the duke will be here to-morrow. By my troth, Isabel, I loved thy brother: if the old fantastical duke of dark corners had been at home, he had lived.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Away with her, and waft her hence to France. And now what rests but that we spend the time With stately triumphs, mirthful comic shows, Such as befits the pleasure of the court? Sound drums and trumpets! farewell sour annoy! For here, I hope, begins our lasting joy.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: We thank you both: yet one but flatters us, As well appeareth by the cause you come; Namely to appeal each other of high treason. Cousin of Hereford, what dost thou object Against the Duke of Norfolk, Thomas Mowbray?
Speaker: KING RICHARD II

Text: A flourish, trumpets! strike alarum, drums! Let not the heavens hear these tell-tale women Rail on the Lord's enointed: strike, I say! Either be patient, and entreat me fair, Or with the clamorous report of war Thus will I drown your exclamations.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: I can hardly believe that, since you know not what you speak. But, if ever the duke return, as our prayers are he may, let me desire you to make your answer before him. If it be honest you have spoke, you have courage to maintain it: I am bound to call upon you; and, I pray you, your name?
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: What is the city but the people?
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: It were no less; but yet I'll make a pause.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Evermore thanks, the exchequer of the poor; Which, till my infant fortune comes to years, Stands for my bounty. But who comes here?
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: I neither care for the world nor your general: for such things as you, I can scarce think there's any, ye're so slight. He that hath a will to die by himself fears it not from another: let your general do his worst. For you, be that you are, long; and your misery increase with your age! I say to you, as I was said to, Away!
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: Thou'rt a tall fellow: hold thee that to drink. Here comes Baptista: set your countenance, sir. Signior Baptista, you are happily met. Sir, this is the gentleman I told you of: I pray you stand good father to me now, Give me Bianca for my patrimony.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: 'Tis good; though music oft hath such a charm To make bad good, and good provoke to harm. I pray, you, tell me, hath any body inquired for me here to-day? much upon this time have I promised here to meet.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Which is his house, beseech you?
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: He hath a garden circummured with brick, Whose western side is with a vineyard back'd; And to that vineyard is a planched gate,
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: My brother was too careless of his charge. But let us hence, my sovereign, to provide A salve for any sore that may betide.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Wrong not her birth, she is of royal blood.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Yet your good will must have that thanks from Rome, after the measure As you intended well.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: Commend me to thy lady.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Bring me to hear them speak, where I may be concealed.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Wash they his wounds with tears: mine shall be spent, When theirs are dry, for Romeo's banishment. Take up those cords: poor ropes, you are beguiled, Both you and I; for Romeo is exiled: He made you for a highway to my bed; But I, a maid, die maiden-widowed. Come, cords, come, nurse; I'll to my wedding-bed; And death, not Romeo, take my maidenhead!
Speaker: JULIET

Text: You shall not be admitted to his sight.
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: My lord, she may be a punk; for many of them are neither maid, widow, nor wife.
Speaker: LUCIO

Text: Give me that mattock and the wrenching iron. Hold, take this letter; early in the morning See thou deliver it to my lord and father. Give me the light: upon thy life, I charge thee, Whate'er thou hear'st or seest, stand all aloof, And do not interrupt me in my course. Why I descend into this bed of death, Is partly to behold my lady's face; But chiefly to take thence from her dead finger A precious ring, a ring that I must use In dear employment: therefore hence, be gone: But if thou, jealous, dost return to pry In what I further shall intend to do, By heaven, I will tear thee joint by joint
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Why, Buckingham, I say, I would be king,
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: And Warwick shall disprove it. You forget That we are those which chased you from the field And slew your fathers, and with colours spread March'd through the city to the palace gates.
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: Then move not, while my prayer's effect I take. Thus from my lips, by yours, my sin is purged.
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Go to, we pardon thee: therefore, in brief, Tell me their words as near as thou canst guess them. What answer makes King Lewis unto our letters?
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Ay, to be murder'd by his enemies.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: What fates impose, that men must needs abide; It boots not to resist both wind and tide.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: Pluck up thy spirits; look cheerfully upon me. Here love; thou see'st how diligent I am
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: In such a one as, you consenting to't, Would bark your honour from that trunk you bear, And leave you naked.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Bishop, farewell: shield thee from Warwick's frown; And pray that I may repossess the crown. 3 KING HENRY VI
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: And so do I. Victorious Prince of York, Before I see thee seated in that throne Which now the house of Lancaster usurps, I vow by heaven these eyes shall never close. This is the palace of the fearful king, And this the regal seat: possess it, York; For this is thine and not King Henry's heirs'
Speaker: WARWICK

Text: I do, my lord; but long I shall not stay I shall return before your lordship thence.
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: O, fie, fie, fie! Thy sin's not accidental, but a trade.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Madam, yourself are not exempt in this, Nor your son Dorset, Buckingham, nor you; You have been factious one against the other, Wife, love Lord Hastings, let him kiss your hand; And what you do, do it unfeignedly.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: O grave and good Paulina, the great comfort That I have had of thee!
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: It then remains That you do speak to the people.
Speaker: MENENIUS

Text: I shall forget, to have thee still stand there, Remembering how I love thy company.
Speaker: JULIET

Text: What, what, what! I shall be loved when I am lack'd. Nay, mother. Resume that spirit, when you were wont to say, If you had been the wife of Hercules, Six of his labours you'ld have done, and saved Your husband so much sweat. Cominius, Droop not; adieu. Farewell, my wife, my mother: I'll do well yet. Thou old and true Menenius, Thy tears are salter than a younger man's, And venomous to thine eyes. My sometime general, I have seen thee stem, and thou hast oft beheld Heart-hardening spectacles; tell these sad women 'Tis fond to wail inevitable strokes, As 'tis to laugh at 'em. My mother, you wot well My hazards still have been your solace: and Believe't not lightly--though I go alone, Like to a lonely dragon, that his fen Makes fear'd and talk'd of more than seen--your son Will or exceed the common or be caught With cautelous baits and practise.
Speaker: CORIOLANUS

Text: Unhappy Claudio! wretched Isabel! Injurious world! most damned Angelo!
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: He's a disease that must be cut away.
Speaker: SICINIUS

Text: By whose direction found'st thou out this place?
Speaker: JULIET

Text: Hold you there: farewell. Provost, a word with you!
Speaker: DUKE VINCENTIO

Text: Too late? why, no; I, that do speak a word. May call it back again. Well, believe this, No ceremony that to great ones 'longs, Not the king's crown, nor the deputed sword, The marshal's truncheon, nor the judge's robe, Become them with one half so good a grace As mercy does. If he had been as you and you as he, You would have slipt like him; but he, like you, Would not have been so stern.
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: When holy Harry died, and my sweet son.
Speaker: QUEEN MARGARET

Text: Say, I will love her everlastingly.
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Out! A mankind witch! Hence with her, out o' door: A most intelligencing bawd!
Speaker: LEONTES

Text: Hush, master! here's some good pastime toward: That wench is stark mad or wonderful froward.
Speaker: TRANIO

Text: Dorset, embrace him; Hastings, love lord marquess.
Speaker: KING EDWARD IV

Text: What shall I swear by?
Speaker: ROMEO

Text: Her husband, knave: wouldst thou betray me?
Speaker: GLOUCESTER

Text: Even so. Heaven keep your honour!
Speaker: ISABELLA

Text: Look, what is done cannot be now amended: Men shall deal unadvisedly sometimes, Which after hours give leisure to repent. If I did take the kingdom from your sons, To make amends, Ill give it to your daughter. If I have kill'd the issue of your womb, To quicken your increase, I will beget Mine issue of your blood upon your daughter A grandam's name is little less in love Than is the doting title of a mother; They are as children but one step below, Even of your mettle, of your very blood; Of an one pain, save for a night of groans Endured of her, for whom you bid like sorrow. Your children were vexation to your youth, But mine shall be a comfort to your age. The loss you have is but a son being king, And by that loss your daughter is made queen. I cannot make you what amends I would, Therefore accept such kindness as I can. Dorset your son, that with a fearful soul Leads discontented steps in foreign soil, This fair alliance quickly shall call home
Speaker: KING RICHARD III

Text: Exton, I thank thee not; for thou hast wrought A deed of slander with thy fatal hand Upon my head and all this famous land.
Speaker: HENRY BOLINGBROKE

Text: Where be these knaves? What, no man at door To hold my stirrup nor to take my horse! Where is Nathaniel, Gregory, Philip? ALL SERVING-MEN: Here, here, sir; here, sir.
Speaker: PETRUCHIO

Text: Look I so pale, Lord Dorset, as the rest?
Speaker: BUCKINGHAM

Text: You may deny that you were not the cause Of my Lord Hastings' late imprisonment.
Speaker: GLOUCESTER
